description: Is this payments or digital-asset firm registered or licensed, where, and is it active: FinCEN MSB registrations (US), NY DFS virtual-currency licensees and trust charters, the EU MiCA register of authorised crypto-asset service providers and the entities national authorities have named as non-compliant (ESMA), Dubai VARA licensed VASPs, Hong Kong SFC licensed virtual asset trading platforms, the UK FCA Financial Services Register (live), plus the firm's LEI record. Returns licensed / flagged / possible_match / not_found with every registration found (authority, number, status, activities, link) and the registries covered, so absence is reported as absence from those registries, not as proof. Use for fintech and VASP onboarding, partner due diligence and crypto-to-bank flows.

jurisdiction.description: Country or region to narrow to (US, US-NY, GB, EU, EU-DE, AE, HK)
